name: dsh-session-manager
description: Archived-session management for DSH: permanent delete entry for archived sessions (sidebar menu + agent tool), with ghost-residue cleanup and residency diagnostics.

meta.title: Session Manager
meta.description: Adds a permanent Delete entry to archived sessions' row menu and a session_delete agent tool. Only archived sessions can be deleted; a resident or running session is refused until it settles, and ghost residue (archive entry whose files are gone) cleans up through the same flow.
